summary.headline: Trigonal Lords and Decans
summary.text: Astrological discussion of Ares and Aphrodite producing adultery, and Aphrodite with Kronos producing sterility or impure marriages. Sections 9–10 define the trigonal lords by day and night for the four zodiacal triplicities, then introduce the 36 decans, co-rising signs, and faces, with Porphyry references and Laurentianus variants.
